goal: Reduce long Biz report waits while adding durable per-admin run history and truthful progress.

facts.claim: The existing client sends sequential waves of four targets.
The supplier contract is per business, not a verified bulk-all-business endpoint.
facts.evidence: Observed fetchViiConversions URL contract in app/lib/vii-conversions.ts.

assumptions.claim: A bounded wave of twelve is acceptable to the supplier.
assumptions.evidence_or_test: Keep a hard server cap, per-target timeout and isolated result errors; do not use unbounded Promise.all.

risks.mitigation: Hard cap each request at twelve, retain waves and cache hits, never retry uncertain requests automatically.
risks.verification: Server rejects more than twelve targets and tests cover the cap.

risks.risk: Mutable progress can be overwritten out of order.
risks.mitigation: Update only while running and only when stored progress is not ahead of the new absolute progress.
risks.verification: Run-history tests cover ordered absolute progress and actor-bound stop.

alternatives.tradeoff: Lowest supplier pressure but preserves the reported twenty-minute operator experience.
Potentially faster but unsafe for supplier limits and Worker timeouts.
Best eventual architecture for very large runs, but adds queue infrastructure not currently verified or authorized for this scoped correction.

acceptance_checks.check: Twelve-target bounded waves pass focused tests.
acceptance_checks.evidence_or_reason: Focused admin and batch tests passed; the client uses twelve-target waves and the route rejects larger requests.

acceptance_checks.check: History survives a new request with actor and exact run fields.
acceptance_checks.evidence_or_reason: The persistence tests passed for actor, range, scope, progress, result counts and actor-bound stop.

acceptance_checks.check: Natural destination displays progress and history.
acceptance_checks.evidence_or_reason: The production build passed, but the authenticated natural destination has not been published or visually exercised in this candidate.

affected_family: Biz batch API, cache, admin progress UI, stop flow and all authorized admin identities.
authorization_boundary: Candidate implementation and tests only; publication remains separate.
remaining_blockers: Natural-destination visual verification and public deployment are pending.
